QuestInfo.name: Same Ol' Triple Volt
QuestInfo.0: As you were leaving the Alcadno Lab, you ran into Triple Volt riding on some weird robot.
QuestInfo.1: Triple Volt are trying to steal your guardian animals again... Man, they were way less annoying when the band was broken up. Well, looks like you have to destroy the #o9390924# to get them under control. How annoying.
QuestInfo.2: Triple Volt ran away once their plan fell apart. AGAIN. Talk to #p1101002# in #m130000000#.
